fireside.speaker: A man, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 57 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Ursula
fireside.text: "215 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Emma
fireside.text: "488 wood. We need 500. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Carlos
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Pavel
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Sanne
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Grace
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Catalina
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Ursula
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Tarek
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Theo
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Obinna
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Sibongile
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Hank speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −16. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 21 days between tiers, not 7.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −23. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 24 days between tiers, not 7.
